title: Okusobya ku lubalama lw’ennyanja
intro: Oyimiridde ku musenyu gw’olubalama lw’ennyanja olwerabirwa, amayengo gye gawuubaala ng’ekitundu ekigezeseddwa ekiragiro eky’obwakatonda. Empewo nzitowa olw’okujjukira okumenya amateeka okwavaako enkyukakyuka eyeewuunyisa. Emyoyo gino gyali baani, era okugezesebwa kwabwe kwali kutya?
clues: Twali kitundu ekyafuna ekiragiro ekitegeerekeka obulungi okuva ewa Mukama waffe, naye ne tufuna engeri gye tukisomooza.
Twabeeranga kumpi n’ekifo eky’amazzi, era eby’okubeezaawo obulamu bwaffe byali bisinziira ku bitonde ebirimu.
Ekigezo kyatujja ku lunaku lwe twalagirwa okwewala emirimu gy’ensi.
Ebitonde by’amazzi byajja gye tuli mu bungi ku lunaku olwo lwennyini, ne bitukema okusukka okugumiikiriza.
Twayiiya akakodyo ak’obukuusa okwetoloola enteekateeka ya Katonda, nga tulowooza nti tusobola okusinga ekiragiro ekyo mu ngeri ey’amagezi.
Okusobya kwaffe kwaleetawo enkyukakyuka eswaza; twafuuka enkima ezinyoomebwa olw’ekiragiro kya Allah.
arabic: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱعْتَدَوْا۟ مِنكُمْ فِى ٱلسَّبْتِ فَقُلْنَا لَهُمْ كُونُوا۟ قِرَدَةً خَـٰسِـِٔينَ
verse: And you had already known about those who transgressed among you concerning the sabbath, and We said to them, "Be apes, despised." (2:65)
